hero.eyebrow: Built with rural women, for rural women
hero.title: Your next chapter starts right where you are.
hero.description: Learn practical skills, meet women who understand your journey, and build a stronger future—one small step at a time.

how.title: How to join
how.description: A welcoming community is just three easy steps away.

steps.title: Create your profile
steps.description: Tell us about your interests and what you would like to learn.

steps.title: Choose your path
steps.description: Explore free lessons, local opportunities, and helpful conversations.

steps.title: Grow together
steps.description: Learn, share your knowledge, and get support when you need it.

why.title: A little support can change a lot.
why.description: Everything here is designed to make learning and finding support feel possible, useful, and close to home.

items.title: Learn useful skills
items.description: Practical, easy-to-follow courses for work, business, and everyday life.

items.title: Find your people
items.description: Connect with women nearby who can share their experience and encouragement.

items.title: Ask without hesitation
items.description: Get guidance from a kind community whenever you are unsure of the next step.

about.title: A community where every woman belongs.
about.description: Rural Women Helper is a safe, supportive space for women in villages to learn, connect, and create more choices for themselves and their families.
about.pointOne: No fees to become a member
about.pointTwo: Skills and support in simple language
about.pointThree: A community that celebrates every step forward

quote.text: When women learn together, their confidence reaches far beyond the classroom.
quote.author: — The Rural Women Helper community

cta.title: You do not have to do it alone.
cta.description: Join a community that is ready to learn, support, and grow with you.

footer: A community built by and for women in villages.
